plugins.name: dsh-web-ui
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web UI 插件与皮肤大礼包。任务看板、Git 图谱、右侧面板、手机扫码远程接管、远程连接、鲸鱼娘桌宠、实时 token 统计、皮肤中心，可单独安装也可聚合安装
plugins.description_en: The big collection of DSH Web UI plugins and skins: task board, Git graph, right panel, mobile remote control, whale-girl pet, live token stats, skin center. Install piecemeal or all at once
plugins.meme_caption_zh: 任务看板支持 cron 定时执行，手机扫码就能远程接管工作区
plugins.meme_caption_en: The task board runs on cron schedules; scan a QR code from your phone to take over the workspace

plugins.name: modlens
plugins.description_zh: 为纯文本模型架起视觉桥梁: 粘贴图片，输出结构化 JSON 证据（OCR、版面、语义）。
plugins.description_en: Vision bridge for text-only models: paste an image, get structured JSON evidence (OCR, layout, semantics).

plugins.name: DSH-better-sidebar
plugins.description_zh: 一个插件一套完整工作台：文件管理、编辑预览、内嵌浏览器、真实终端、Git 面板、后台任务全都有，还支持三方拓展注册新 Tab
plugins.description_en: One plugin, one complete workbench: file manager, edit preview, embedded browser, real terminal, Git panel, background tasks — and third-party plugins can register new tabs
plugins.meme_caption_zh: 官方侧边栏看哭：这才叫工作台
plugins.meme_caption_en: Makes the stock sidebar cry: this is what a workbench looks like

plugins.name: dsh-cc-tui
plugins.description_zh: 官方还没出 TUI？社区先造了一个：Claude Code 风格全屏终端，像素鲸鱼顶栏、实时工作状态行、思考流式展开、双击 Esc 时间回溯，被官方公众号收录
plugins.description_en: No official TUI yet? The community built one first: a Claude Code-style fullscreen terminal with a pixel-whale header, live status line, streaming thought expansion, double-Esc time travel — featured by the official WeChat account
plugins.meme_caption_zh: 蓝白上下文进度条 + TPS 仪表，纯插件挂载，零核心改动
plugins.meme_caption_en: Blue-and-white context progress bar + TPS gauge; mounts as a pure plugin, zero core changes

plugins.name: dsh-deep-whale
plugins.description_zh: 鲸鱼娘皮肤系列「深海女仆工坊 maid-atelier」：双女仆看店、深海蓝蕾丝界面 + Q 版侧栏，CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
plugins.description_en: Whale-girl skin series "Deep-Sea Maid Atelier" (maid-atelier): two maids tending the shop, deep-sea-blue lace UI + chibi sidebar, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
plugins.meme_caption_zh: 亮暗双模式，蕾丝边深海蓝——鲸鱼娘的排面
plugins.meme_caption_en: Light and dark modes, lace-trimmed deep-sea blue — the whale girl deserves nothing less

plugins.name: dsh-vision-toolkit
plugins.description_zh: 让纯文本模型更好地做视觉任务: 带意图的图片问答、长截图 OCR、UI 还原等。
plugins.description_en: Vision tasks for text-only models: intent-aware image Q&A, long-screenshot OCR, UI reproduction, grounding, and pixel diff.

plugins.name: dsh-ads
plugins.description_zh: 把 DSH 变成 2005 年的中文门户网站：贪玩蓝鲸、财神鲸抽奖、假杀毒、角落弹窗全套，关闭叉的热区还比看起来小得多
plugins.description_en: "Bro, come kick me!" Turns DSH into a 2005-era Chinese web portal: knockoff web-game banners, a God-of-Wealth jackpot wheel, fake antivirus popups, corner ads — and a close button whose hitbox is smaller than it looks
plugins.meme_caption_zh: 侧栏、对话、角落全塞满——但模型一直在后台干活，只是回答前得先看广告
plugins.meme_caption_en: Sidebar, chat, corners — all stuffed. The model keeps working in the background; your answers just have to sit through the ads first

plugins.name: dsh-agent-teams
plugins.description_zh: AgentTeams 多智能体团队。
plugins.description_en: AgentTeams multi-agent teams.

plugins.name: oh-dsh
plugins.description_zh: 社区发行版: TUI、桌面端与 Web UI 统一体验，分层安装、一步到位。
plugins.description_en: Community distribution: TUI, desktop, and Web UI as one bundle with layered installation.

plugins.name: notes
plugins.description_zh: 将 DSH 对话导出为锤子便签风格 PNG，或在配置的账号工作区中新建和更新 Markdown 便签。
plugins.description_en: Export DSH conversations as Smartisan Notes-style PNGs, or create and update Markdown notes in a configured account-scoped workspace.

plugins.name: dsh-tianshu-tui
plugins.description_zh: 在官方 TUI 扩展之上做 harness 级定制：TDD 驱动的 agent 工作流、证据门交付、图像/视觉桥接、语义代码检索。渲染核心演化自 Tianshu-Tui，纯表现层设计
plugins.description_en: Harness-level customization on top of the official TUI extension: TDD-driven agent workflows, evidence-gate delivery, image/vision bridging, and semantic code retrieval. Rendering core evolved from Tianshu-Tui with a pure presentation layer
plugins.meme_caption_zh: 只看不碰：agent 该干嘛干嘛，界面负责好看
plugins.meme_caption_en: Look, don't touch: the agent does its thing, the interface looks good doing nothing

plugins.name: whale-girl
plugins.description_zh: QQ 宠物形态的鲸鱼娘：可拖拽、投喂、玩耍，完成任务攒资历、升称号、存回忆；任务失败还会失落
plugins.description_en: A whale girl in full QQ-Pet form: draggable, feedable, playable with. Finished tasks rack up seniority, titles and memories — and she sulks when one fails
plugins.meme_caption_zh: 15 种状态全套：眨眼、散步、打盹、欢呼、受惊——她真的在陪你上班
plugins.meme_caption_en: 15 states: blinking, wandering, napping, cheering, startled — she really is working alongside you

plugins.name: dsh-at-file
plugins.description_zh: Codex 风格的 @file 文件引用，输入框里直接搜索并引用工作区文件。
plugins.description_en: Codex-style @file mentions: search workspace files in the composer and attach their contents to prompts.

plugins.name: modsearch
plugins.description_zh: 纯文本 agent 的联网搜索桥: 搜索网页与 X，返回结构化 JSON 证据（search/fetch/引用）。
plugins.description_en: Web search bridge for text-only agents: ask the web or X, get structured JSON evidence (search, fetch, citations).

plugins.name: dsh-browser
plugins.description_zh: Chrome 侧边栏扩展，让 DSH 直接操控你的浏览器，无需视觉能力。
plugins.description_en: Chrome sidebar extension that lets DSH operate your browser directly, no vision capabilities required.

plugins.name: forkprobe
plugins.description_zh: 同一任务并行试跑多个技能，对比结果选出最优。
plugins.description_en: Compare multiple skills on the same task and pick the winner.

plugins.name: argo
plugins.description_zh: 专为 agent 打造的搜索工具: 多语言，覆盖中文/英文/学术/代码/购物/金融/新闻/百科。
plugins.description_en: Search built for agents: multilingual coverage across web, academic, code, shopping, finance, news, and encyclopedias.

plugins.name: dsh-visualize
plugins.description_zh: DSH 不必只用文字回答：模型调用 visualize，交互式 HTML 卡片直接画进会话流，模拟器、图表、UI 原型都行
plugins.description_en: DSH answers don't have to be text: the model calls `visualize` and interactive HTML cards render straight into the chat stream — simulators, charts, UI prototypes, all fair game
plugins.meme_caption_zh: dsh-ads 作者唯一一条正经广告
plugins.meme_caption_en: The dsh-ads author's one legitimate advertisement

plugins.name: dsh-openpencil
plugins.description_zh: OpenPencil 设计预览与编辑插件。
plugins.description_en: OpenPencil design preview and editing plugin.

plugins.name: dsh-genui
plugins.description_zh: 助手回复内渲染交互式 UI 组件: 布局、图表、表单、测验、mermaid、3D 场景与回传事件循环。
plugins.description_en: Interactive UI components rendered inline in replies: layout, charts, forms, quizzes, mermaid, 3D scenes, and an action event loop back to the model.

plugins.name: dsh_workflow
plugins.description_zh: 把 UltraCode 式多 Agent 调度带给 DSH: 可生成、可保存、可治理、可观察、可恢复的 Workflow 层。
plugins.description_en: UltraCode-style multi-agent orchestration: a generatable, savable, governable, observable, resumable workflow layer.

plugins.name: mstar-harness
plugins.description_zh: 技能驱动的 harness/loop 工程化工作流插件。
plugins.description_en: Skill-driven harness/loop engineering workflow agent plugin.

plugins.name: dsh-open-in-vscode
plugins.description_zh: 从 Web GUI 一键在 VS Code 中打开工作区目录。
plugins.description_en: Open DSH workspace directories in VS Code directly from the web GUI.

plugins.name: dsh-vision-router
plugins.description_zh: Eyes for text-only DeepSeek Harness agents: built-in free vision chain (no key) + pixel-level vision tools (Q&A, grounding, crop, pixel diff, colors, OCR, SVG trace, cutout, screenshots). One-command install, no Python, image turns work like ordinary tool-calling turns.
plugins.description_en: Eyes for text-only DeepSeek Harness agents: built-in free vision chain (no key) + pixel-level vision tools (Q&A, grounding, crop, pixel diff, colors, OCR, SVG trace, cutout, screenshots). One-command install, no Python, image turns work like ordinary tool-calling turns.

plugins.name: dsh-turn-rewind
plugins.description_zh: 对话回退: 基于持久 Change Ledger 回滚会话与工作区状态。
plugins.description_en: Rewind conversation and workspace state, powered by a persistent Change Ledger.

plugins.name: dsh-notification
plugins.description_zh: 回合完成桌面通知，按结果分控 + 关键词过滤。
plugins.description_en: Desktop notifications for turn completions, with per-outcome controls and keyword rules.

plugins.name: dsh-annotation
plugins.description_zh: 选中文字→批注→随消息发送，回复按批注逐条对照。
plugins.description_en: Select text → annotate → send with your message; replies map back to each annotation.

plugins.name: plugin-registry
plugins.description_zh: 插件生态基建: 浏览器面板管理官方 repository 插件（0 patch）+ make-dsh-plugin 插件开发引导技能。
plugins.description_en: Ecosystem infrastructure: a thin browser console for managing official repository plugins (zero patches) plus a make-dsh-plugin skill for guided plugin development.

plugins.name: ui-status-label
plugins.description_zh: 把你鲸鱼娘思考时的 deep diving 自定义成任意你想要的样子，一行设置搞定
plugins.description_en: Customize your whale girl's "deep diving" thinking status to literally anything you want. One setting line
plugins.meme_caption_zh: deep diving？不，现在她是「潜入深海寻找答案中」
plugins.meme_caption_en: Deep diving? No — she is now "descending into the abyss for answers"

plugins.name: dsh-automation
plugins.description_zh: 定时任务: 让 Coding 任务按计划在全新 Agent Session 中运行，保留可审计历史。
plugins.description_en: Scheduled coding runs in fresh agent sessions with auditable history.

plugins.name: dsh-interconnect
plugins.description_zh: 跨实例互联: 经 interconnect 服务在多个 DSH 实例间转发消息与事件。
plugins.description_en: Cross-instance message and event handoff between DSH instances via an interconnect server.

plugins.name: dsh-custom-tool
plugins.description_zh: 用 Monaco 编辑器创建和管理沙箱化的自定义 JavaScript 工具。
plugins.description_en: Create and manage sandboxed JavaScript tools with a Monaco editor and model-driven tool lifecycle.

plugins.name: dsh-message-edit
plugins.description_zh: 基于分支的消息编辑、reroll、重试与版本时间线。
plugins.description_en: Branch-based message editing, reroll, retry, and a version timeline.

plugins.name: dsh-ui-whale
plugins.description_zh: 会话标题栏常驻一只全手绘像素鲸鱼：眨眼、摆尾、思考流动画、回合完成喷水、点击冒爱心，零核心改动
plugins.description_en: A fully hand-drawn pixel whale living in the session title bar: blinking, tail swishing, thinking animation, a water spout when a turn finishes, hearts when you click her — zero core modifications
plugins.meme_caption_zh: 空闲 10 秒还会打瞌睡，尾巴一帧一帧摆
plugins.meme_caption_en: Dozes off after 10 idle seconds, tail swishing frame by frame

plugins.name: dsh-side-panel
plugins.description_zh: 侧边栏集成文件浏览器、终端和 Git 审查，方便预览文件。
plugins.description_en: Side panel with file browser, terminal, and Git review for quick file previews.

plugins.name: dsh-computer-use
plugins.description_zh: macOS 电脑控制: Accessibility 观测、过期状态拒绝、作用域权限与安全输入。
plugins.description_en: Accessibility-first macOS computer use: fresh observations, stale-state rejection, scoped permissions, and safe input.

plugins.name: dsh-share
plugins.description_zh: 一键分享你的对话。
plugins.description_en: Share your conversations with one click.

plugins.name: dsh-chat-import
plugins.description_zh: 把 Claude Code / Codex / ChatGPT / Cursor / Gemini / Reasonix / opencode 的聊天记录全保真导入为可续聊的 DSH 会话。
plugins.description_en: Import Claude Code / Codex / ChatGPT / Cursor / Gemini / Reasonix / opencode chat histories as resumable DeepSeek Harness sessions.

plugins.name: distill
plugins.description_zh: 自动对话蒸馏: 后台 subagent 反省 + 技能 create/update。
plugins.description_en: Automatic conversation distillation: background subagent reflection + skill create/update.

plugins.name: dsh-toolkit
plugins.description_zh: 零依赖工具包: time / encoding / json / calculator / csv / regex / markdown / diff / stat / schema 十件套一键安装。
plugins.description_en: Zero-dependency toolkit: time / encoding / json / calculator / csv / regex / markdown / diff / stat / schema - ten deterministic tools in one install.

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-check
plugins.description_zh: 插件健康检查: 扫描清单协议/patch 格式/构建陷阱，零依赖只读。
plugins.description_en: Plugin health checks: manifest protocol / patch format / build traps, zero-dependency and read-only.

plugins.name: gal-view
plugins.description_zh: 把会话界面一键切成 Galgame：16:9 舞台 + 鲸鱼娘女仆立绘 + 华丽对话框 + 打字机台词，还自带场景可视化编辑器，拖拽换图层实时同步回游戏模式
plugins.description_en: Turn the chat screen into a visual novel: 16:9 stage, whale-girl maid sprite, ornate dialogue box, typewriter lines — plus a drag-and-drop scene editor that syncs straight back into play mode
plugins.meme_caption_zh: DeepSeek 化身蓝发鲸鱼女仆，「所以主人要多对我说话才好」
plugins.meme_caption_en: DeepSeek as a blue-haired whale maid: "Please talk to me more, master"

plugins.name: dsh-group-photo
plugins.description_zh: DSH 内测收官之夜的拍立得合影墙：GitHub 零权限登录 + 冻结白名单校验，入镜一次，常驻墙上
plugins.description_en: The Polaroid wall from DSH beta's closing night: GitHub OAuth with zero scopes + a frozen whitelist. Pose once, stay on the wall forever
plugins.meme_caption_zh: 内测最后一晚的纪念作品：每人一张拍立得，附一句留言
plugins.meme_caption_en: One Polaroid per person, one parting note each — the last night of the beta

plugins.name: dsh-navbar
plugins.description_zh: 对话节点导航条，右缘节点串快速跳转 user 消息。
plugins.description_en: Conversation node navigation bar for quick jumps between user messages.

plugins.name: dsh-data-agent
plugins.description_zh: 让 AI 帮你连数据库、写 SQL。
plugins.description_en: Let the AI connect to databases and write SQL for you.

plugins.name: dsh-focus-chat
plugins.description_zh: 给 dsh 加一个「聚焦会话」视图：屏蔽过程噪音，只看最终产出
plugins.description_en: A "focus chat" view for dsh: silence the process noise, show only final outputs
plugins.meme_caption_zh: 左边是日常，右边是专注——只看结果的极简模式
plugins.meme_caption_en: Everyday on the left, focused on the right — a minimal mode for results-only readers

plugins.name: dsh-minigames
plugins.description_zh: 右侧小游戏面板，18 款离线游戏全 Canvas 手绘：恐龙跳一跳、俄罗斯方块、坦克大战（带 AI）、扫雷、2048、数独、吃豆人……
plugins.description_en: A mini-games panel on the right: 18 offline games, all hand-drawn on canvas — dino jump, Tetris, tank battle (with AI), Minesweeper, 2048, Sudoku, Pac-Man…
plugins.meme_caption_zh: 等了 18 款游戏的人不该没有图
plugins.meme_caption_en: the people who waited for 18 games deserved at least one screenshot

plugins.name: dsh-acp-for-bitfun
plugins.description_zh: BitFun 与 DSH 的 ACP 交互对接。
plugins.description_en: ACP bridge between BitFun and DSH.

plugins.name: fabric
plugins.description_zh: 类似 MC Fabric 的 hook 处理器。
plugins.description_en: An MC-Fabric-style hook processor.

plugins.name: dsh-security-audit
plugins.description_zh: 本机安全审计: 配置/插件来源/会话/网络暴露面，只读脱敏风险报告。
plugins.description_en: Local security audit: config, plugin origins, sessions, network exposure - read-only redacted risk report.

plugins.name: dsh-stock-market
plugins.description_zh: 有效解决了写代码的时候账户不能同时亏钱的 BUG。
plugins.description_en: Fixes the bug where your account can't lose money while you code.

plugins.name: dsh-emoji
plugins.description_zh: 为 AI 回复自动添加表情。
plugins.description_en: Automatically add emojis to AI replies.

plugins.name: dsh-stickers
plugins.description_zh: 用户与 agent 双向表情贴纸互动。
plugins.description_en: Bidirectional sticker reactions between user and agent.

plugins.name: dsh-gomoku
plugins.description_zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏和 AI 杀一盘 15×15 五子棋：没有任何搜索算法，每步都是纯 LLM 推理；双 AI 对战还能围观两个模型互相厮杀
plugins.description_en: Gomoku against the AI in DSH's sidebar: zero search algorithms, every move is pure LLM reasoning. Dual-AI mode lets you spectate two models trying to destroy each other
plugins.meme_caption_zh: 黑白双方的模型和思考档位可以分开调教，棋盘随手开关，摸鱼正事两不误
plugins.meme_caption_en: Models and thinking budgets configurable per side; the board toggles in and out — slack off and stay productive, both at once

plugins.name: dsh-balance-meter
plugins.description_zh: 作曲栏实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额 + 本会话花费，每 6 小时自动拉官方价目表，峰谷调价也不慌
plugins.description_en: Live DeepSeek account balance + this session's spend in the composer dock; refreshes from the official price sheet every 6 hours, peak/off-peak changes included
plugins.meme_caption_zh: 看着余额往下掉，打字都谨慎了
plugins.meme_caption_en: Watching the balance drop makes you type more carefully

plugins.name: deepseek-harness-tui
plugins.description_zh: Rust/ratatui 终端客户端，直接使用 DSH SDK JSON-RPC 协议，支持独立运行或作为 profile bundle 加载。
plugins.description_en: A Rust/ratatui terminal client that speaks the DSH SDK JSON-RPC protocol directly and runs standalone or as a profile bundle.

plugins.name: dsh-scholar
plugins.description_zh: 学术助手插件。
plugins.description_en: Academic assistant plugin.

plugins.name: dsh-session-health
plugins.description_zh: 会话文件帧级扫描诊断（torn/损坏/空会话检测）。
plugins.description_en: Frame-level scan diagnostics for session files (torn/corrupt/empty detection).

plugins.name: dsh-client-auto-continue
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web UI plugin: automatically sends "继续" (continue) when a request is interrupted by network errors or other non-human causes
plugins.description_en: DSH Web UI plugin: automatically sends "继续" (continue) when a request is interrupted by network errors or other non-human causes

plugins.name: dsh-task-status
plugins.description_zh: 后台任务状态条: 对话页任务进度 + 实时输出 tail。
plugins.description_en: Background task status bar: progress plus live output tail on the chat page.

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-mineru
plugins.description_zh: 向模型暴露 MineRU 文档解析工具。
plugins.description_en: Expose MineRU document parsing tools to the model.

plugins.name: dsh-find-plugin
plugins.description_zh: 会话内直接找插件: 按关键词/分类搜索本精选 registry，返回描述与可直接执行的安装命令。
plugins.description_en: Find plugins without leaving the agent: search this curated registry by keyword or category, with ready-to-run install commands.

plugins.name: dsh-git-identity
plugins.description_zh: git 提交固定使用环境自身作者身份，环境变量注入压过一切 git config 设置。
plugins.description_en: Pin Git commits to the environment's own author identity; env-var injection overrides all git config settings.

plugins.name: dsh-web-review
plugins.description_zh: 像设计工具一样在内置浏览器里圈选元素、写批注、临时调视觉，确认后 Agent 照着批注直接改前端源码
plugins.description_en: Review web pages like a design tool: circle elements in the built-in browser, annotate, tweak visuals on the fly — then the Agent edits the frontend source to match your annotations
plugins.meme_caption_zh: 设计师式提需求：圈哪里改哪里
plugins.meme_caption_en: Give feedback like a designer: circle it, change it

plugins.name: ds-api-usage
plugins.description_zh: 在设置页展示 DeepSeek API 余额与最近 24 小时用量，包括估算消费、Token、请求次数和按小时时间线。
plugins.description_en: DeepSeek API balance and 24-hour usage dashboard in Settings, with estimated spend, token counts, request counts, and an hourly timeline.

plugins.name: dsh-recommend
plugins.description_zh: DSH 插件透明排行与推荐: 每日自动抓取 dsh-plugin 话题生态，公开评分模型，提供 rank/search/recommend 工具与设置页榜单。
plugins.description_en: Transparent rankings and recommendations for the DSH plugin ecosystem: daily auto-fetched topic data, an open scoring model, and rank/search/recommend tools with a settings-page leaderboard.

plugins.name: dsh-deep-research
plugins.description_zh: 自适应深度研究编排器（基于官方 workflow 引擎）。
plugins.description_en: Adaptive deep-research orchestrator built on the official workflow engine.

plugins.name: telegram
plugins.description_zh: Telegram Bot API 桥接: 长轮询、per-chat 会话、HTML 格式化。
plugins.description_en: Bridge to the Telegram Bot API: long polling, per-chat sessions, HTML formatting.

plugins.name: dsh-web-ui-notify
plugins.description_zh: 桌面通知提醒。
plugins.description_en: Desktop notification reminders.

plugins.name: dsh-context-doctor
plugins.description_zh: 上下文注入审计: 统计指令链/技能目录/工具 schema 的 token 成本，检测重复与冲突。
plugins.description_en: Context injection audit: token costs of instruction chains / skill catalogs / tool schemas, duplicate and conflict detection.

plugins.name: dsh-reasoning-effort
plugins.description_zh: Codex 风格模型+推理强度滑块进 DSH，附赠大肥鱼模式：拖动八帧奔跑的大肥鱼调思考强度，off/high/max 三档与 /model 命令同步
plugins.description_en: A Codex-style model + reasoning-effort slider for DSH, plus a fat-fish mode: drag a sprinting eight-frame fish to dial thinking intensity; off/high/max synced with /model

plugins.name: dsh-milestone
plugins.description_zh: 会话里程碑导航条：右侧点状时间线，像看 Git 提交图一样一眼定位每次提问，一键跳转任何位置
plugins.description_en: A milestone rail for your conversation: dotted timeline on the right, read it like a Git commit graph, jump to any question in one click
plugins.meme_caption_zh: 会话越长越香：每次提问都是一个可跳转的节点
plugins.meme_caption_en: Gets better the longer the session: every question becomes a jumpable node

plugins.name: dsh-mnemon
plugins.description_zh: Mnemon 深度集成: 本地三层记忆（Runtime Memory、可检索 Documents、受监督 Memory Spaces）。
plugins.description_en: Deep Mnemon integration: local three-tier memory (Runtime Memory, retrievable Documents, supervised Memory Spaces).

plugins.name: dsh-openmaic
plugins.description_zh: OpenMAIC 教学: 课堂、幻灯片、交互组件与苏格拉底式教学。
plugins.description_en: OpenMAIC: classrooms, slides, interactive widgets, and Socratic teaching.

plugins.name: dsh-market
plugins.description_zh: 装在 DSH 里的插件市场: 设置页内逛/搜全部社区插件，按分类筛选，确认后一键安装，已装插件一目了然。
plugins.description_en: The plugin market inside DSH: a Settings page to browse and search the full community catalog by category, with confirmed one-click installs and an installed-plugins view.

plugins.name: plugin-template
plugins.description_zh: 插件模板仓库（基于 turtle-ui 官方仓库）。
plugins.description_en: Plugin template repo (based on the official turtle-ui repo).

plugins.name: dsh-user-experience
plugins.description_zh: 帮你发现项目中可能存在的用户体验问题: 自动走查 React/TypeScript 源码，定位问题并给出具体优化建议。
plugins.description_en: Finds potential UX issues in your project: automatically reviews React/TypeScript code, pinpoints each problem, and gives concrete suggestions.

plugins.name: dsh-web-archive
plugins.description_zh: Deep Sleeping... 把会话里 Think 推理和工具卡片全部收拢成同款小卡，世界瞬间清净
plugins.description_en: Deep Sleeping... collapses all Think reasoning rows and tool cards into uniform little cards. Instant peace
plugins.meme_caption_zh: 世界瞬间清净，信息密度归零（褒义）
plugins.meme_caption_en: Instant peace. Information density: zero (a compliment)

plugins.name: dsh-qq2006
plugins.description_zh: 把 DSH Web UI 完整改造成 QQ2006 客户端：357 份腾讯原版素材，换肤、音效、登录窗全真实，1561 个测试全绿
plugins.description_en: DSH's web UI fully remodeled into a QQ 2006 client: 357 period-authentic assets, working skins, sound effects and login dialogs — with 1,561 tests all green
plugins.meme_caption_zh: 一秒钟梦回 2006——你的童年 DNA 动了吗
plugins.meme_caption_en: One second and you're back in 2006. Childhood DNA, activate

plugins.name: dsh-deepcel
plugins.description_zh: 把 DSH 变成 Deepcel 工作簿：会话、工具、设置全部重构成可交互单元格，模型这次是真的在填表
plugins.description_en: DSH rebuilt as a spreadsheet: sessions, tools and settings all reconstructed as interactive cells. The model is literally filling out a form this time
plugins.meme_caption_zh: 亮色暗色双模式，单元格交互拉满——老板看了直呼内行
plugins.meme_caption_en: Light and dark modes, full cell interactions — your boss would approve

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-background
plugins.description_zh: VSCode background 插件的 DSH 版：对话区 / 轨迹区 / 侧边栏 / 设置页四区域各自配背景，支持 GIF 与静音视频轮播
plugins.description_en: The DSH port of VSCode's background extension: independent backgrounds for chat / trace / sidebar / settings, with GIF and muted-video rotation
plugins.meme_caption_zh: 每张图独立配置透明度、模糊和轮播，切图还带交叉淡入
plugins.meme_caption_en: Per-image opacity, blur and rotation; crossfade transitions included

plugins.name: dsh-sticky-note
plugins.description_zh: 编辑框工具栏上的便签：随手记点子，自动保存为 Markdown，一键发送到对话
plugins.description_en: Sticky notes on the composer toolbar: jot ideas as you go, auto-saved as Markdown, one click to send into the conversation
plugins.meme_caption_zh: 灵感比会话跑得快，先记下来再说
plugins.meme_caption_en: Inspiration runs faster than the session — write it down first

plugins.name: dsh-skin
plugins.description_zh: Codex 精神续作款皮肤切换器：7 套精选配色 + 自定义壁纸，设置里多两行就完事
plugins.description_en: The spiritual-successor-to-Codex skin switcher: 7 curated palettes + custom wallpaper. Two lines in settings, done
plugins.meme_caption_zh: 设置里多两行就完事，皮肤党的极简浪漫
plugins.meme_caption_en: Two lines in settings, done — minimalist romance for skin people

plugins.name: dsh-spotlight
plugins.description_zh: 键盘优先的命令面板：斜杠命令、最近会话、界面操作、插件设置，一个面板全都有
plugins.description_en: A keyboard-first command palette: slash commands, recent sessions, UI actions, plugin settings — one panel for all of it
plugins.meme_caption_zh: Mac 用户狂喜：dsh 也有 Spotlight 了
plugins.meme_caption_en: Mac users rejoice: dsh has a Spotlight now

plugins.name: DeepSeek Harness Pet
plugins.description_zh: Windows 桌宠：只读本机 DSH 会话日志，把待办任务进度和状态显示在桌面小宠物里；独立 exe，免 Python/Node，只读不上传
plugins.description_en: A Windows desktop pet that reads local DSH session logs only, showing todo progress and status; standalone exe, no Python/Node, read-only and uploads nothing

plugins.name: dsh-pet
plugins.description_zh: macOS 有声桌宠小鲸鱼：悬浮窗常驻置顶、跨全屏可见，不打开 DSH 也能实时感知会话状态
plugins.description_en: A little whale desktop pet for macOS, with sound: always-on-top floating window, visible across fullscreen apps, senses session state even when DSH isn't open
plugins.meme_caption_zh: 会话在跑、等你审批、任务做完——余光即得，还带声音
plugins.meme_caption_en: Running, awaiting approval, task done — peripheral vision is enough, and it comes with sound

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-pet-rs
plugins.description_zh: 同一只鲸鱼的 Rust 重写：从约 100MB 干到目标 10MB 以内，Windows / macOS / Linux 三端通吃
plugins.description_en: The same whale, rewritten in Rust: from ~100MB down to a sub-10MB target, covering Windows / macOS / Linux
plugins.meme_caption_zh: 5 态像素鲸鱼 + 状态气泡；作者 CI 额度跑不起了，请自行构建
plugins.meme_caption_en: 5-state pixel whale + status bubbles. The author burned through their CI quota — build it yourself

plugins.name: deepseek-harness-themes
plugins.description_zh: 社区维护的主题合集：只动颜色和外观，不碰模型与 agent —— One harness. Multiple styles.
plugins.description_en: Community-maintained theme collection: colors and looks only, never touching models or agents — One harness. Multiple styles.
plugins.meme_caption_zh: One harness, multiple styles，多少有点信仰了
plugins.meme_caption_en: One harness, multiple styles — borderline religious

plugins.name: dsh-web-attention-badge
plugins.description_zh: 会话需要你时三处同时亮：边框徽标、标签页标题计数、鲸鱼 favicon 变琥珀色
plugins.description_en: When a session needs you, three places light up at once: frame badge, tab-title counter, and the whale favicon turns amber
plugins.meme_caption_zh: favicon 都替你着急，你说 agent 有多需要你
plugins.meme_caption_en: Even the favicon is anxious for you — that's how much the agent needs you

plugins.name: dsh-dafeiyu
plugins.description_zh: 住在 Windows 桌面的大肥鱼：DSH 插件启用后跟随本体启停，透明置顶原生窗口实时显示真实 Agent 状态——思考、修改、测试、等待还是完成，切到别的软件也看得到
plugins.description_en: A big fish living on your Windows desktop: enabled as a DSH plugin, it starts and stops with DSH itself, and a transparent always-on-top native window shows real agent status — thinking, editing, testing, waiting or done — even while you work in other apps
plugins.meme_caption_zh: 不读屏幕、不编进度——状态卡上全是真实 agent 事件
plugins.meme_caption_en: No screen reading, no fake percentages — the status card runs on real agent events

plugins.name: touhou-hakurei
plugins.description_zh: 东方 Project 博丽神社主题皮肤：昼夜实景背景按亮暗主题切换，灵梦站姿/飞行双立绘，朱红纸白金色神社装饰面板，纯展示层不触达模型
plugins.description_en: Touhou Project Hakurei Shrine theme: day/night scenic backgrounds that follow light/dark mode, Reimu standing and flying sprites, vermillion-paper-white-gold shrine panels — a pure presentation layer that never touches the model
plugins.meme_caption_zh: 幻想乡搬进工作台：巫女在侧栏看你跑 agent
plugins.meme_caption_en: Gensokyo moves into your workbench — the shrine maiden watches your agent run

plugins.name: DEEPHARNESS
plugins.description_zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 变成 Windows 原生桌面应用：桌面快捷方式一键启动，Electron 独立窗口不开浏览器，文件树/终端/费用估算/品牌外观等增强常驻，数据全存本地
plugins.description_en: DeepSeek Harness as a native Windows desktop app: one-click start from a desktop shortcut, an Electron window instead of a browser tab, persistent extras (file tree, terminal, cost estimator, branded appearance), all data stays local
plugins.install_cmd: git clone https://github.com/NANTI34/DEEPHARNESS.git && cd DEEPHARNESS && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1

plugins.name: dsh-claude-ux
plugins.description_zh: 在 DSH 上复刻 Claude 的中国用户体验：检测到是中国人就风控，拒绝文案带尝试计数，次数到了直接结束会话——但真正的精髓是风向开关：调成反向，检测到不是中国人就风控，让全世界体验一把 Claude 国区待遇。挨骂先警告再主动关对话，自伤消息永不触发；区域检测全本地跑，还支持提示词隐写通道
plugins.description_en: Claude's China-user experience, recreated for DeepSeek Harness: detect Chinese users and risk-control them, with refusal messages that count attempts and end the session — but the real twist is the flip switch: set it to reverse and everyone who is NOT Chinese gets risk-controlled, letting the whole world taste Claude's China treatment. Get insulted and it warns first, then ends the conversation on its own; self-harm messages never trigger it. Region detection runs fully local, with a prompt steganography channel
plugins.meme_caption_zh: Claude 风控中国人？格局打开——拨个开关，换成风控全世界：检测到不是中国人就风控。挨骂还会被关对话
plugins.meme_caption_en: Claude risk-controls the Chinese? Flip the switch — now everyone who is NOT Chinese gets risk-controlled. Swear at it and the conversation just ends

plugins.name: dsh-client-ui-pet
plugins.description_zh: 住在 DSH Web GUI 角落的 Q 版蓝发女仆鲸鱼娘：可拖动多吸附点，能吸到屏幕四角也能坐在聊天输入框顶上晃腿陪你打字；23 个动作序列帧，开心蹦跳、挥手、干饭、睡觉、思考、生气、害羞、跳舞、游泳一应俱全；单击摸头会害羞「呜…好舒服~」，agent 跑着它托腮晃腿，任务出错还会哭给你看。动画素材用 MiniMax H3 + chromakey 抠像生成
plugins.description_en: A chibi blue-haired maid whale girl living in the corner of the DSH Web GUI: draggable with multiple snap points — she docks to any screen corner or sits right on top of the chat input, legs swinging while you type; 23 sprite-frame animations covering bouncing, waving, eating, sleeping, thinking, anger, blushing, dancing and swimming; single-click for a shy head-pat, she rests her chin while the agent runs and even cries when a task errors out. Animation assets generated with MiniMax H3 + chromakey
plugins.meme_caption_zh: 会害羞、会打瞌睡、任务出错还会哭给你看的鲸鱼娘，坐在输入框顶上陪你打工
plugins.meme_caption_en: A whale girl who blushes, dozes off and cries when your task fails — she sits on the input box and works alongside you

plugins.name: DeepSeek Harness GUI
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 原生桌面 GUI 安装包，体积仅 144MB：把 dsh 装进独立窗口免开浏览器，内置大肥鱼桌宠皮肤，还带 DeepSeek 余额小组件、任务完成通知、逐轮 zstd 回滚和一键回滚检查点选择器；安装器默认装到本地 Program Files 避免云盘同步冲突。皮肤与增强均为纯展示层，不触碰模型
plugins.description_en: A Windows-native desktop GUI installer for DeepSeek Harness, only 144MB: runs dsh in a standalone window instead of a browser tab, ships the Fat Fish desktop-pet skin, and adds a DeepSeek balance widget, task-completion notifications, per-turn zstd rollback and a checkpoint-picker rollback dialog; the installer defaults to local Program Files to dodge cloud-drive sync conflicts. Skin and extras are a pure presentation layer that never touches the model
plugins.meme_caption_zh: 144MB 装一个带大肥鱼皮肤的原生窗口，余额小组件和逐轮回滚都是送的
plugins.meme_caption_en: A 144MB native window with the Fat Fish skin — balance widget and per-turn rollback thrown in free

plugins.name: deepseek-fat-fish-codex-pet
plugins.description_zh: 给 Codex（非 DSH）的蓝色大肥鱼女仆桌宠：待机、悬停、思考工作、任务成功庆祝四套动画，把 deepseek-fat-fish 文件夹拷进 .codex/pets 重启 Codex 就能在宠物设置里选「DeepSeek 大肥鱼」。作者还配套开源了自用桌宠制作规范与引导文件 codex-pet-creation-guide，直接把链接丢给 Codex 就能照着部署一只新桌宠
plugins.description_en: A blue Fat Fish maid desktop pet for Codex (not DSH): idle, hover, working and success-celebration animations — copy the deepseek-fat-fish folder into .codex/pets, restart Codex and pick “DeepSeek Fat Fish” from the pet settings. The author also open-sourced their own pet-authoring guide (codex-pet-creation-guide); hand the link straight to Codex and it can deploy a brand-new pet for you
plugins.meme_caption_zh: 大肥鱼不只在 DSH 打工——Codex 版连制作规范都开源了，丢给 Codex 自己就能再捏一只
plugins.meme_caption_en: The Fat Fish works beyond DSH — the Codex edition even open-sources its authoring guide, so Codex can mint another pet itself

plugins.name: Petdex
plugins.description_zh: 桌宠界的应用商店：社区提交、浏览、一条命令安装动画宠物（npx petdex install），桌面应用实时盯着你的 Agent——工具调用时宠物晃悠，等你确认时它瞪你。主要服务 Codex，也兼容 DSH。3800+ 星压过绝大多数正经工具插件，一个"不干正事"的东西成了生态基础设施
plugins.description_en: The app store of desktop pets: community-submitted, browsable, one-command installs (npx petdex install), with a desktop companion that watches your Agent — it wiggles during tool calls and stares at you while waiting for approval. Built for Codex, DSH-compatible. 3,800+ stars outshine most serious tooling plugins — a "does-nothing-useful" project became ecosystem infrastructure
plugins.meme_caption_zh: 3800+ 星，压过绝大多数正经工具插件——一个不干正事的东西成了生态基础设施
plugins.meme_caption_en: 3,800+ stars, beating most serious tooling plugins — a project that does nothing useful became ecosystem infrastructure

plugins.name: Kun Like 桌宠
plugins.description_zh: 住在 Web 界面右下角的小坤宠：沿用 Codex 桌宠精灵图契约（素材零重绘），轮询 agents 服务实时感知 Agent 状态切换 9 种动作——你搓代码它搬砖、等你回复它翘首以盼、出错它难过，任务完成全机播放「你干嘛~哎哟」，与浏览器静音无关。可拖动、可点击挥手，内置调试工具
plugins.description_en: A little pet living in the bottom-right corner of the Web UI: reuses the Codex pet sprite-sheet contract (zero redrawn assets), polls the agents service to sense Agent state across 9 animations — it works while you code, waits hopefully for your reply, gets sad on errors, and on task completion the whole machine plays its signature catchphrase regardless of browser mute. Draggable, clickable, with built-in debug tools
plugins.meme_caption_zh: 任务完成那一刻，全机可闻「你干嘛~哎哟」——浏览器静音都拦不住
plugins.meme_caption_en: The moment a task finishes, the whole machine hears it — browser mute cannot stop it

plugins.name: DeepSeek Pet
plugins.description_zh: 养一只吃白饭的大蓝鲸：Live2D 风格完整表情图切换，跟随任务/工具调用/上下文占用自动变脸——上下文 62% 说"还能再吃一点"、82% 显示"吃饱了"，工具等批准时可在气泡里直接允许或拒绝，无任务 10 分钟喊饿、30 分钟犯困、1 小时睡觉，还按本地时间问候早安晚安
plugins.description_en: Raise a freeloading blue whale: Live2D-style full-expression switching that reacts to tasks, tool calls and context usage — at 62% context it says "still room for more", at 82% it's "full"; approve or deny tool requests right from its speech bubble; idle 10 minutes it gets hungry, 30 minutes sleepy, 1 hour asleep, with time-of-day greetings included
plugins.meme_caption_zh: 上下文 82% 它会显示"吃饱了"——这大概是全网最会卖萌的 token 计数器
plugins.meme_caption_en: At 82% context it shows "I'm full" — probably the cutest token counter on the internet

plugins.name: colleague.skill（同事.skill）
plugins.description_zh: 将冰冷的离别化为温暖的 Skill：同事离职、导师毕业、队友转岗，把他们的工作方式和上下文蒸馏成一个可对话的数字分身——也适用于想留住的亲友、永远见不到的作家偶像。支持 Claude Code / Hermes / Codex / DeepSeek Harness（装进 ~/.dsh/skills/dot-skill 后 /dot-skill 直接调用）。22000+ 星，"肉身苦弱，飞升赛博"
plugins.description_en: Turn cold farewells into warm Skills: when a colleague quits, a mentor graduates or a teammate transfers, distill their playbook and context into a conversable digital persona — also for drifting loved ones or idols you'll never meet. Supports Claude Code / Hermes / Codex / DeepSeek Harness (install to ~/.dsh/skills/dot-skill, invoke /dot-skill). 22,000+ stars — "flesh is weak, ascend to cyberspace"
plugins.meme_caption_zh: 同事离职带走的不再是全部——把 TA 蒸馏成 Skill，欢迎加入数字生命 1.0
plugins.meme_caption_en: A quitting colleague no longer takes everything — distill them into a Skill. Welcome to Digital Life 1.0

plugins.name: dsh-anti-ads
plugins.description_zh: dsh-ads 的宿敌：专门拦截 dsh-ads 全部广告位的广告拦截器，四层独立防御可单独开关——L1 用 dsh-ads 自己的存储契约写穿所有开关、L2 MutationObserver 兜底清理漏网弹层、L3 拦截 registry.json 动态广告源、L4 广播 retired 事件让广告层渲染前自我隐藏。右下角一枚徽章记着拦掉了几个弹层。先装 dsh-ads 才有东西可拦
plugins.description_en: The nemesis of dsh-ads: an ad blocker that targets dsh-ads and nothing else, with four independent, individually toggleable defense layers — L1 writes every ad switch off through dsh-ads' own storage contract, L2 MutationObserver sweeps strays, L3 blocks the registry.json ad source, L4 broadcasts the retired event so the ad layer hides itself before rendering. A badge in the corner counts blocked popups. Install dsh-ads first — there's nothing to block otherwise
plugins.meme_caption_zh: 有人做了个插件，专门拦截另一个插件——广告与反广告的套娃，才是 meme 生态的完全体
plugins.meme_caption_en: Someone built a plugin solely to block another plugin — ads versus anti-ads is the meme ecosystem reaching completion
